model.cellPitch: one half of the reconstructed edge lattice
model.paint: even route positions paint one filled square exactly once
model.blank: odd route positions paint nothing and erase nothing; may revisit a target cell
model.steps: 8 neighbours, each transition toggles 1/0, no direct H/V or V/H change
model.repetitions: no repeated painted cell or geometric segment; point crossings allowed
model.scope: a separate constructive raster model, not the source artist algorithm or pixel-perfect video width
